note: He misses the occupation criterion as written — a salaried software engineer is neither a business owner nor a physician — but meets everything else, and the income test he passed by conduct rather than claim: he took CAD 8,280 in two instalments on a credit card with no hesitation and never questioned the number. Health is the classically neglected corner of a desk-bound life ("the only thing you're engaging is your fingers and your brain") and he is well past the deconditioned exclusion, having already taken himself from 98 kg to 90 kg by his own effort while adding weekend swimming. Good-to-great is arguable in both directions: he still has 10 kg to lose and calls it stubborn belly fat, which leans toward rescue, but his framing is competitive rather than desperate — he wants to be the fittest in his friendship group. Counted as a match. The material finding here is not on the five criteria at all: he told the rep in his first answer that he understood the coaching to be for thirty and above and that he will not be thirty for a couple of months. Whatever that rule is, this sale ran straight through it without acknowledgement, and it is the second closed deal in the corpus to sit outside a stated boundary.
